link: Forgot your master password? Erase this vault…
title: Erase this vault
what: This erases the vault on this computer for good: every item, the Secret Key and the paired devices stored here. Other devices you paired keep their own copies, and nothing is sent anywhere.
then: Afterwards you can start a new vault, set this computer up from another device you already use, or restore a backup.
lost: Items that exist only on this computer are lost. Restoring a backup brings them back.
settingsHint: Starts over on this computer: a new vault, or join another device.
